sections.title: How do you feel?

q.prompt: Which word means “feeling good and smiling”?

captions: Hello, and welcome to Camday English, Stage 3. In this lesson: How do you feel?
Name feelings and give a reason with ‘because’.
Here are some new words. Happy. Feeling good and smiling. Sad.
Feeling bad, maybe crying. Angry. Feeling very cross. Listen and say them. happy
sad
angry.
And some more words. Scared. Afraid of something. Tired. Needing to sleep. Excited.
Very happy about something that will happen. Listen and say them. scared
tired
excited.
Time for a question. The video will stop. Which word means: feeling good and smiling?
Now some grammar: because. Use ‘because’ to give a reason.
It joins two parts of a sentence. For example: I am happy because it is my birthday.
For example: She is tired because she ran a long way.
Now listen, and read along. Ben's bad morning. Ben woke up late. ‘Oh no!’ he said.
He was worried because the school bus comes at eight.
He ran to the bus stop, but the bus was gone. Ben felt sad and a little angry.
Then Dad came out with the car keys. ‘I can take you,’ he said with a smile.
Ben got to school on time. He felt happy because his dad helped him.
Another question. The video will stop. Why was Ben worried?
Well done! Today you learned new words, like happy, sad, angry. You practised because.
And you read Ben's bad morning. Now try the practice questions. See you next time!

sections.title: A new friend

q.prompt: Which word means “a little afraid to talk to new people”?
q.reason: “shy” means a little afraid to talk to new people.

options.fb: “share” means give part of something to others.
“kind” means nice and helpful to others.

captions: Hello, and welcome to Camday English, Stage 3. In this lesson: A new friend.
Use the present simple to talk about things people do every day.
Here are some new words. Shy. A little afraid to talk to new people. Share.
Give part of something to others. Kind. Nice and helpful to others.
Listen and say them. shy
share
kind.
And some more words. Smile. Make a happy face. Together. With each other. Lonely.
Sad because you are alone. Listen and say them. smile
together
lonely.
Time for a question. The video will stop.
Which word means: a little afraid to talk to new people?
Now some grammar: Present simple. Use the present simple for things that happen often.
Add -s or -es after he, she or it. For example: I walk to school every day.
For example: She walks to school every day.
Now listen, and read along. Rosa's first week. Rosa is new at school.
She comes from another country and she is shy. On Monday she sits alone at lunch.
She feels lonely. On Tuesday a girl called Mia smiles at her.
‘Do you want to sit with me?’ she asks. Now Rosa and Mia eat lunch together every day.
Mia helps Rosa with English, and Rosa teaches Mia a song from her country.
Another question. The video will stop. Why is Rosa shy?
Well done! Today you learned new words, like shy, share, kind.
You practised present simple. And you read Rosa's first week.
Now try the practice questions. See you next time!
